title: SESSION313_PORTFOLIO_IMPACT_ANALYSIS
methodology: Portfolio-level impact estimation of Wave 1 Domain E certification. Computes: certified count delta, Domain E improvement, UIQS gain, progress toward 2,500 target. Based on S312 inventory data (375 Domain E items: 208 certified, 129 archived, 38 unprocessed) and S313 certification decisions (10 CERTIFY).

domain_e_impact.domain_e_progress: Wave 1 (10/43 replacement groups) = 23% of replacement phase

uiqs_impact.trend: Rising — modernization content is higher quality than legacy certified pool

completion_scenario.description: All 43 replacement groups + 38 certification candidates completed (S314-S317)
completion_scenario.remaining_gap_description: Gap to 2,500 driven by: Pack C Sections C-F (150 items), Pack A Sections B/C/F (19 items), Pack D Section C (50 DL-026 items), Pack C Section B (54 DL-008 items)
